description: Delete an element (objective, initiative or KPI) created by mistake or duplicated, with its correlations, KPI readings and update log; elements of lower matrices that deployed it keep their place but lose that link. It cannot be undone. For an element the organization dropped, prefer update_element_status with status "cancelled": its history stays.

element_id.description: UUID of the element (from list_objectives or get_matrix_data)

name: delete_element
